name: GitHub Copilot app
license: Proprietary (GitHub Copilot product; technical preview terms apply)

runner.notes: Install the GitHub Copilot desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), sign in with a Copilot-eligible GitHub account (or BYO key if available), connect the fixture repo, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree (or start a session on that folder with New worktree), provide prompt.md as the session prompt or from an issue, review plan/diff/browser/terminal, open PR if in scope, then harness-verify. Record app version, Copilot plan, model, local vs cloud session, and interventions. Do not mix cloud sessions with local worktree runs in one score.

inclusion: Direct Class A agent-native desktop ADE built on GitHub: parallel agent sessions with Git worktrees, issue-to-PR shipping, integrated review/browser/terminal, skills, MCP, and automations.
pricing_model: Works with GitHub Copilot plans (Free/Pro/Pro+/Max and business tiers per product page) or bring-your-own key messaging. Technical preview access historically gated to existing Copilot subscribers; re-check plan entitlements at install time. Cloud agent/Actions usage may incur separate billable usage.
public_stack_signals: Official product page: desktop experience for agent-driven development built natively on GitHub for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
My Work view for sessions, issues, pull requests, and automations across connected repositories.
Every session can run in its own git worktree with isolated files, conversation, and task state.
Native GitHub context: issues, PRs, search, checks, Agent Merge for review comments and failing checks.
Skills, MCP servers, scheduled workflows, canvases, optional cloud sessions and automations.
